title: Command
description: Frontmatter schema for slash-command definitions under src/apothem/commands/. Reconciled to the live command corpus: every shipped command carries name, version, updated, description, argument-hint, disable-model-invocation, portability, and allowed-tools.

name.description: Human-readable kebab-case name matching the slash-command surface (the filename without .md), declared without a leading slash.

description.description: Capability-led statement of the command's purpose and invocation triggers.

version.description: SemVer version of the command definition.

updated.description: ISO 8601 date of the command's last revision.

argument-hint.description: Usage hint shown to the operator describing the command's accepted arguments and flags.

disable-model-invocation.description: When true, the command is reached only by explicit /<name> invocation, never auto-selected by the model from its description.

portability.description: Portability classification across harness adapters (e.g. universal, claude-code-only).

allowed-tools.description: Comma-separated tools the command pre-approves while it runs: read-only by default. A side-effecting tool (Bash, PowerShell, Write, Edit, NotebookEdit, WebFetch) appears only as a scoped permission rule such as Bash(git log *), and the bare "*" wildcard is not accepted, because harnesses that honor this field run pre-approved tools without asking.

examples.name: eval
examples.description: Model-agnostic language-model evaluation campaign. Defines a dataset and scorer, runs a candidate model over it, scores every output, and emits a regression-aware report.
